code_generation_authority: Human-written independent grammar-based generator; no self-invention of generator language or target-free discovery
test_strategy: Generate reproducible YAML plain scientific notation scalars from fixed grammar, derive expected float64 from strconv.ParseFloat; quoted counterparts must retain string type; malformed exponent candidates must remain strings; include positive controls
independent_requirement: YAML 1.2 core schema allows exponent with no fractional dot, quoted scalars remain strings
source_diff_selection: Automatically collect all modified .go paths between exact base/head, exclude _test.go, require precisely one modified implementation file, restore that file from pinned base in HEAD_WITH_AUTOMATIC_NON_TEST_GO_SOURCE_REVERT

qualification.BASE: Original unmodified package tests already known green on the same pinned base from independent run 38549639235. Newly generated grammar cases must expose >=5 genuine typed scientific-notation failures while unchanged controls pass.
qualification.CONTRIBUTOR_HEAD: All 256 generated numeric cases and controls pass natively; if not, report residual or semantic-oracle dispute, never silently weaken the generator.
qualification.HEAD_WITH_AUTOMATIC_NON_TEST_GO_SOURCE_R: Same failure case identities as BASE (or subset satisfying preregistered decisive failures), and controls remain intact.
qualification.independent_test_source_hash: All three arms use identical generated fixture and unchanged Go test bytes
qualification.unsupported: No claim of automatic issue discovery, native App integration, superiority to another agent, general YAML conformance or L7.
